headline: Names a post office building in Evanston, Illinois, after former congressman and judge Abner J. Mikva.
what_it_does: This law officially designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1101 Davis Street in Evanston, Illinois, as the "Abner J. Mikva Post Office Building." It is an honorary naming and does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or how it is run. The official summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: Took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
